content: Hooktheory Trends represents suggestions as probabilities for what commonly follows a chosen chord, backed by a large song-analysis corpus, and exposes example progressions such as C-Dm-G, Am-F-C-G, and C-G-Am-F. This supports concise progression suggestions and optional formula labels, but Jay-6 should use a curated static catalogue rather than importing statistical ranking or implying one correct next chord.
